name: IAPStack
description: Self-hosted in-app purchase verification and entitlement infrastructure.

IAPSTACK_PROTECTION_ACTIVE_KEY_ID.description: Identifier for the active encryption key.

IAPSTACK_PROTECTION_KEY.description: Required 32-byte root key. Generate it locally with: openssl rand -base64 32

IAPSTACK_PROTECTION_FINGERPRINT_KEY.description: Required stable 32-byte fingerprint key. Generate a separate value with: openssl rand -base64 32

IAPSTACK_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_KEY.description: Installation-only administrator bearer. Remove it after creating the first durable administrator key.

IAPSTACK_METRICS_BEARER_TOKEN.description: Dedicated bearer for the protected Prometheus metrics endpoint.
